name: tor-event-calendar-ai
description: Manage a connected private calendar, prepare social drafts and reconcile authorized publication receipts.

interface.longDescription: Connect your private nambli calendar through browser sign-in, choose the intended account, and find events, create meetings, prepare social drafts, move appointments and manage named File fields. The core calendar skill is explicitly invoked; content and publication workflow skills are discoverable for relevant nambli requests. Publication requires a separately available, authorized publisher. Confirmed publication receipts and links are recorded in the calendar; calendar writes never publish or schedule social posts. Account access stays scoped to the selected connection. The hosted MCP connection needs no local runtime. An optional local CLI is included for users who choose it.
defaultPrompt: Use nambli to show today's events in my connected account.
Use nambli to create a project meeting tomorrow at 09:30 in Europe/Bucharest.
Use nambli to prepare a Reddit draft and ask for missing content.
